title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are used to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic by resampling with replacement from the original data. In this table, each row represents a bootstrap sample.

title: Analyzing the Table
text: The table shows replicates in rows and columns. The rowmeans, rowvars, and rowmedians are calculated for each row, while colmeans, colvars, and colmedians are calculated for each column.

title: Effect of Sample Size on Variance
text: Increasing the sample size generally decreases the variance of the sample mean. This is because a larger sample size provides more information about the population, leading to more stable estimates.

title: Identifying Changes to Decrease Variance
text: Which change would decrease the variance of the sample mean?
choices: Keeping the sample size the same
